tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the constant-gradient pilot leaves its sink dependence and open branch ambiguous. The discriminating probe directly tests these alternatives.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition and branch behavior cannot be identified separately.
The observed bridge and flux-conservation signatures point to the static siphon family, not a coupled memory trajectory.
The pilot alone cannot distinguish them reliably from sink-coupled saturation; varying the gradient is more informative.
